search.title: Jean-Étienne Championnet

search.title: Jean-Étienne Liotard
search.snippet: Jean-Étienne Liotard (French pronunciation: [ʒɑ̃ etjɛn ljɔtaʁ]; 22 December 1702 – 12 June 1789) was a Genevan painter, pastellist, printmaker, art theorist

search.title: Jean-Étienne-Marie Portalis
search.snippet: Jean-Étienne-Marie Portalis (1 April 1746 – 25 August 1807) was a French jurist and politician in the time of the French Revolution and the First Empire
